posts.title: Nokia PSE-6s: Scaling the Future of Optical Networking
posts.summary: Nokia’s sixth‑generation super‑coherent Photonic Service Engine (PSE‑6s) leverages 5 nm silicon and CSTAR silicon photonics to deliver up to 1.2 Tb/s per wavelength, 50 % higher capacity, and the ability to bond two wavelengths for 2.4 Tb/s transport, enabling single‑line‑card delivery of three 800 GE services and up to 25 % more fiber capacity. It extends 800 GE reach to 2 000 km—tripling current distances—while cutting interface count and eliminating many regenerators, and it reduces power per bit by 40 % and overall network power consumption by up to 60 % through greater efficiency and longer reach. Integrated telemetry and AI‑driven analytics provide real‑time monitoring, fault detection, and automated recovery, creating a smarter, more sustainable optical network for the growing 800 GE era.
